headline: Indian benchmarks crash after reversing morning gains, Nifty breaks below 22,400 while Sensex drops over 700 points.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex and Nifty sharply reversed early gains, plunging more than 1,000 points from intraday highs.
Profit-taking erased morning rebounds driven by IT stocks, ending a two-week winning streak.
Global economic concerns, including a selloff in European bonds and weakness in European equities, hurt sentiment.
Uncertainty around foreign institutional investor (FII) flows contributed to domestic market pressure.
whatHappening: Sensex crashed up to 1,314 points from its day's high while Nifty tested the 22,400 support level.
JSW Steel posted a 225% YoY jump in Q2 net profit to Rs 5,279 crore alongside 21% revenue growth.
Adani Power reported Q2 profit surging 134% YoY to Rs 6,919 crore with revenue jumping 45%.
Newgen Software recovered off its session lows following the announcement of its Q2 results.
summary: Indian markets faced severe intraday volatility as early gains were wiped out in a sharp selloff, pushing Nifty towards 22,400. Global weakness and profit booking dragged indices down after a three-day slide attempt at recovery. Despite overall market weakness, JSW Steel and Adani Power delivered robust Q2 financial results.
